title: Build a Sentence — WBS 1
description: 語順が入れ替わった語句を並べ替えて正しい文を作ります（10 問・約 7 分）

items.context: What did you think of the museum?
items.answer: The museum guide who showed us the paintings was excellent.

items.context: I heard Tom might move abroad.
items.answer: Do you know if he is planning to go to Canada?

items.context: We’re thinking about booking that hotel.
items.answer: Can you tell me whether any rooms will be available there next weekend?

items.context: I’m really excited about the movie tonight.
items.answer: What time does the movie start?

items.context: The project report is due next Friday.
items.answer: Do you know how long it will take to finish everything?

items.context: I’m visiting your hometown in January.

items.answer: I enjoyed the activities that were organized by the instructors.

title: Write an Email — Study Room Reservation Problem
description: 7 分・80〜120 語。状況に沿ったメールを書きます
promptText:
Write an Email
You will read some information and use the information to write an email.
You will have 7 minutes to write the email.
You recently booked a study room in the campus library for a group project meeting.
When your group arrived, another group was already using the same room, and they also had a reservation confirmation.
Your group had to look for another place to work, and it was noisy and hard to concentrate.
You want to inform the library staff about the problem and ask how to avoid this situation in the future.
Write an email to the library staff. In your email, do the following.
・Explain what happened with the study room reservation.
・Describe how the problem affected your group.
・Ask what the library can do to prevent this from happening again.
Write as much as you can and in complete sentences.
subject: Study Room Reservation Problem
sampleAnswer:
Dear Library Staff,

I am writing about a problem my group had with a study room reservation yesterday. I booked Room 204 from 6:00 to 8:00 p.m. through the online system and received a confirmation, but when we arrived another group was already in the room and said they had the same time reserved. As a result, the five of us had to move to the open area on the first floor, which was noisy and made it hard to discuss our project. Could you please check what went wrong with the booking system and let me know how we can avoid this kind of double booking in the future? I would really appreciate any advice, such as whether we should also confirm our reservation at the desk.

Best regards,
promptJa:
メールを書く
これからいくつかの情報を読み、その情報を使ってメールを書きます。
メールを書く時間は 7 分です。
あなたは最近、グループプロジェクトのミーティングのために、大学図書館の自習室を予約しました。
しかしグループで部屋に行くと、すでに別のグループがその部屋を利用しており、そのグループも予約確認メールを持っていました。
あなたのグループは別の場所を探さなければならず、その場所はうるさくて集中しにくい環境でした。
あなたは、この問題について図書館スタッフに知らせ、今後同じことが起きないようにしたいと考えています。
図書館スタッフにメールを書きなさい。メールの中で、次のことを行ってください。
・自習室の予約で何が起こったのか説明する。
・その問題がグループにどのような影響を与えたか述べる。
・今後このようなことが起こらないよう、図書館側でどのような対応ができるか尋ねる。
できるだけ多く書き、完全な文で書きなさい。
宛先・件名：
To: studyrooms@rivercollege.edu
Subject: Study Room Reservation Problem

title: Write an Email — Question about Online Volunteer Application
description: 7 分・80〜120 語。状況に沿ったメールを書きます
promptText:
Write an Email
You will read some information and use the information to write an email.
You will have 7 minutes to write the email.
Your university recently started a new community volunteer program and created a website where students can apply online. You visited the site and decided to apply for two volunteer activities. However, after you filled out the form and clicked “submit,” the page froze and you did not see any confirmation message. You are not sure your application was received.
Write an email to the volunteer program coordinator. In your email, do the following.
・Tell the coordinator what you like about the new volunteer program.
・Describe the problem you had with the online application form.
・Ask about the status of your application and what you should do next.
Write as much as you can and in complete sentences.
subject: Question about Online Volunteer Application
sampleAnswer:
Hi Coordinator,

I hope you are doing well. I wanted to say that I’m very interested in the new community volunteer program at Lakeview University; I think it’s a great idea to connect students with local organizations. Yesterday, I tried to apply for two activities using the online form on the website. After I filled in my information and clicked “submit,” the page froze and never showed a confirmation message, so I’m not sure if my application was sent successfully. Could you please check whether you received my application and let me know if I need to submit it again? I would really appreciate any help you can provide.

Best regards,
promptJa:
メールを書く
これからいくつかの情報を読み、その情報を使ってメールを書きます。
メールを書く時間は 7 分です。
あなたの大学では最近、新しいコミュニティ・ボランティア・プログラムが始まり、学生がオンラインで応募できるウェブサイトが作られました。あなたはそのサイトを見て、2つのボランティア活動に応募することにしました。しかし、申込フォームに入力して「submit」をクリックしたところ、ページが固まってしまい、確認メッセージも表示されませんでした。応募がきちんと送信されたかどうか分かりません。
ボランティア・プログラムのコーディネーターにメールを書きなさい。メールの中で、次のことを行ってください。
・新しいボランティア・プログラムのどんな点が良いと思うか伝える。
・オンライン申込フォームでどのような問題があったか説明する。
・自分の応募が今どうなっているのか、また今後どうすべきかを尋ねる。
できるだけ多く書き、完全な文で書きなさい。
宛先・件名：
To: volunteer@lakeviewuniversity.edu
Subject: Question about Online Volunteer Application

title: Write an Email — Project Management App
description: 7 分・80〜120 語。状況に沿ったメールを書きます
promptText:
Write an Email
You will read some information and use the information to write an email.
You will have 7 minutes to write the email.
Your coworker, Kevin, recently suggested that your team start using a new project management app to organize tasks. You agreed to try it for a few weeks. However, the app has been difficult to use, and it has caused some confusion about deadlines. Several team members are unhappy with it, and you want to talk with Kevin about other options.
Write an email to Kevin. In your email, do the following.
・Explain what problems your team has had with the new app.
・Describe how the team has reacted to using it.
・Suggest alternative ways to manage your team’s tasks.
Write as much as you can and in complete sentences.
subject: Project Management App
sampleAnswer:
Hi Kevin,

I hope you’re doing well. Thanks again for suggesting the new project management app for our team; I appreciate that you’re always looking for ways to improve how we work. However, after using it for the past two weeks, we’ve had some difficulties. The interface is a bit confusing, it takes several steps just to update simple tasks, and the notifications don’t always appear, so a few deadlines were almost missed. Several team members have said they would prefer to go back to our shared spreadsheet or use a simpler app. Would you be open to talking about other options at our next meeting, maybe combining a basic checklist with our calendar so everything is easier to follow?

Best regards,

[Your Name]

title: Write an Email — Final Project Group Assignment
description: 7 分・80〜120 語。状況に沿ったメールを書きます
promptText:
Write an Email
You will read some information and use the information to write an email.
You will have 7 minutes to write the email.
Yesterday, your professor held an important class meeting to introduce the final group project and assign students to groups. On the same morning, you suddenly felt sick and had to visit the campus clinic. Because of this, you missed the class and do not know which group you are in or what you are supposed to do for the project. You want to contact your professor.
Write an email to your professor. In your email, do the following.
・Apologize for missing the class and briefly explain why you were absent.
・Ask for information about the group you were assigned to.
・Ask what you should do to catch up on the project.
Write as much as you can and in complete sentences.
subject: Final Project Group Assignment
sampleAnswer:
Dear Professor Lee,

I’m writing to apologize for missing class yesterday. I woke up feeling very sick and had to go to the campus clinic, so I wasn’t able to attend the meeting about the final group project. I heard that groups were assigned and that you explained the project requirements, but I don’t know which group I’m in or what tasks we are supposed to do. Could you please let me know which group I was placed in and who my group members are? I would also appreciate any instructions or materials I should review so that I can catch up and be prepared for our first group meeting.

Best regards,

[Your Name]

title: Write an Email — Question about my short story file
description: 7 分・80〜120 語。状況に沿ったメールを書きます
promptText:
Write an Email
You will read some information and use the information to write an email.
You will have 7 minutes to write the email.
A new online fiction magazine is asking readers to submit short stories, and you decided to send one of your stories. You filled out the online submission form and attached a file. Later that day, you realized that you attached the wrong file—it was an early draft, not your final version. You want to contact the editor and ask what to do.
Write an email to the editor of the magazine. In your email, do the following.
・Tell the editor what you like about the new magazine.
・Explain the mistake you made with your story file.
・Ask if it is possible to send the correct version of your story.
Write as much as you can and in complete sentences.
subject: Question about my short story file
sampleAnswer:
Dear Editor,

I’m writing because I really enjoy the new Silver Lane Stories magazine. I like how you publish short, imaginative pieces from new writers and make them available online for free. Yesterday I submitted one of my short stories through your website, but I realized later that I attached the wrong file—it was an early draft, not the final version I wanted to share. Could you please let me know if it is possible to replace that file with the corrected version of my story? I would be very grateful if you could tell me how to resend it or whether I should submit it again.

Best regards,

[Your Name]

title: Write an Email — Thoughts on the team-building event
description: 7 分・80〜120 語。状況に沿ったメールを書きます
promptText:
Write an Email
You will read some information and use the information to write an email.
You will have 7 minutes to write the email.
Your coworker, Kevin, recently organized an after-work team-building event at an indoor sports center. He chose the place and encouraged everyone to join. You went with the rest of the team, but the event did not go as well as you had hoped. The center was very crowded and noisy, and some of the activities were too physical for a few team members. You want to tell Kevin how the team felt and suggest a different type of event for next time.
Write an email to Kevin. In your email, do the following.
・Explain what parts of the event were difficult for the team.
・Describe how team members felt about the activities.
・Suggest different ideas for a future team activity.
Write as much as you can and in complete sentences.
subject: Thoughts on the team-building event
sampleAnswer:
Hi Kevin,

Thanks again for taking the time to organize the team-building event last Friday. It was nice that so many of us could get together outside the office, and I appreciate your effort. However, the sports center turned out to be very crowded and noisy, and some of the games were quite intense. A few people mentioned that the fast-paced activities were a bit too physical for them, so they felt uncomfortable joining in and just watched from the side. Would you be open to trying a different kind of event next time, maybe a quiet dinner, a board-game night, or a simple coffee meetup? I think something more relaxed would allow everyone to participate and enjoy talking with each other.

Best regards,

[Your Name]

title: Write an Email — Question about my membership price
description: 7 分・80〜120 語。状況に沿ったメールを書きます
promptText:
Write an Email
You will read some information and use the information to write an email.
You will have 7 minutes to write the email.
Last month, you joined the campus fitness center. At the front desk, the staff member told you that there was a discounted “student membership” price, so you filled out a form and signed up. This week, you looked at your bank statement and noticed that you were charged the regular price instead of the student price. You want to contact the fitness center about this.
Write an email to the fitness center staff. In your email, do the following.
・Explain how and when you signed up for the membership.
・Describe the problem you found with the price you were charged.
・Ask what they can do to correct the mistake and how to avoid it in the future.
Write as much as you can and in complete sentences.
subject: Question about my membership price
sampleAnswer:
Dear Fitness Center Staff,

I am writing to ask about the price of my membership. I joined the center about three weeks ago at the front desk, and the staff member there told me I could sign up for the discounted student membership, so I filled out the form and paid with my bank card. This week I checked my bank statement and saw that I was charged the regular price instead of the student price. Could you please check my account and let me know if the amount can be adjusted or if a refund is possible? I would also appreciate any advice on how to make sure I am correctly registered as a student member in the future.

Best regards,

[Your Name]

title: Write an Email — Question about résumé workshop
description: 7 分・80〜120 語。状況に沿ったメールを書きます
promptText:
Write an Email
You will read some information and use the information to write an email.
You will have 7 minutes to write the email.
Your university’s career center recently offered a free workshop on how to write résumés and cover letters. You registered online and planned to attend. The day before the workshop, the time was changed from 3:00 p.m. to 1:00 p.m., but you did not see the email about the change. As a result, you arrived at 3:00 p.m. and missed most of the workshop. You want to contact the career center.
Write an email to a staff member at the career center. In your email, do the following.
・Explain why you missed most of the workshop.
・Say why the workshop topic is important for you.
・Ask if there is a way for you to receive the information you missed.
Write as much as you can and in complete sentences.
subject: Question about résumé workshop
sampleAnswer:
Dear Career Center Staff,

I am writing about the résumé and cover letter workshop that was held yesterday. I had registered online and planned to attend at 3:00 p.m., but I did not notice the email saying that the time was changed to 1:00 p.m. Because of this, I arrived at 3:00 and only caught the last few minutes of the session. This topic is very important to me because I will start applying for internships soon and want to make sure my application materials are strong. Could you please let me know if there are slides, handouts, or another session that I can use to learn what I missed? I would really appreciate any help.

Best regards,

[Your Name]
